---
title: "LIQPLAT data quality summary"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(arrow)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "00-data", "results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

input_paths <- c(
  consort_ipd = here("data", "private", "consort_ipd.parquet"),
  recruitment = here(results_dir, "analysis-recruitment.parquet"),
  cohort_follow_up = here(results_dir, "analysis-cohort.parquet"),
  qol = here(results_dir, "analysis-qol.parquet"),
  taooh = here(results_dir, "analysis-taooh.parquet"),
  ctdna_samples = here(results_dir, "analysis-ctdna-samples.parquet"),
  ctdna_analyses = here(results_dir, "analysis-ctdna-analyses.parquet"),
  alterations = here(results_dir, "analysis-alterations.parquet")
)

if (!all(file.exists(input_paths))) {
  stop("Run 00-data/01-build-analysis-datasets.qmd first.")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: read

datasets <- map(input_paths, \(path) read_parquet(path) |> as.data.frame())

schemas <- names(input_paths) |>
  set_names() |>
  map(\(domain) read_yaml(here("data", "schema", paste0(domain, ".yml"))))
```

## Completeness

```{r}
#| label: completeness

qc_summary <- datasets |>
  imap(\(data, domain) {
    columns <- intersect(names(schemas[[domain]]$columns), names(data))

    tibble(
      domain = domain,
      column = columns,
      n_rows = nrow(data),
      n_missing = map_int(columns, \(column) sum(is.na(data[[column]]))),
      missing_proportion = if (nrow(data) == 0L) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        map_dbl(columns, \(column) mean(is.na(data[[column]])))
      }
    )
  }) |>
  list_rbind()
```

## Logic checks

```{r}
#| label: logic

key_checks <- datasets |>
  imap(\(data, domain) {
    key <- as.character(schemas[[domain]]$primary_key)

    tibble(
      domain = domain,
      check = "primary_key_duplicates",
      n_violations = if (length(key) > 0) sum(duplicated(data[key])) else 0L
    )
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

cohort <- datasets$cohort_follow_up
horizon_days <- config$analysis$horizon_days

endpoint_checks <- tibble(
  domain = "cohort_follow_up",
  check = c(
    "primary_follow_up_outside_horizon",
    "unrestricted_follow_up_shorter_than_primary",
    "potential_follow_up_shorter_than_unrestricted",
    "primary_death_inconsistent_with_unrestricted_endpoint"
  ),
  n_violations = c(
    sum(
      is.na(cohort$survival_time_days) |
        cohort$survival_time_days < 0 |
        cohort$survival_time_days > horizon_days
    ),
    sum(
      is.na(cohort$survival_time_days_unrestricted) |
        cohort$survival_time_days_unrestricted < cohort$survival_time_days
    ),
    sum(
      is.na(cohort$potential_follow_up_days) |
        cohort$potential_follow_up_days < cohort$survival_time_days_unrestricted
    ),
    sum(
      cohort$event_death == 1L & (
        is.na(cohort$status_death_unrestricted) |
          cohort$status_death_unrestricted != 1L |
          cohort$survival_time_days_unrestricted != cohort$survival_time_days
      )
    )
  )
)

logic_summary <- bind_rows(key_checks, endpoint_checks) |>
  mutate(status = if_else(n_violations == 0L, "pass", "fail"))
```

```{r}
#| label: write

write_parquet(qc_summary, here(results_dir, "data-qc-summary.parquet"))
write_parquet(logic_summary, here(results_dir, "data-qc-logic.parquet"))

failed_checks <- logic_summary |>
  filter(is.na(n_violations) | n_violations != 0L)

if (nrow(failed_checks) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Data logic checks failed: ",
    str_flatten_comma(paste(failed_checks$domain, failed_checks$check))
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-completeness
#| tbl-cap: "Non-identifying completeness summary"
#| echo: false

qc_summary |>
  filter(!column %in% c("id", "sample_id", "alteration_id", "assessment_id")) |>
  mutate(missing_proportion = round(missing_proportion, 4)) |>
  kable()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-logic
#| tbl-cap: "Non-identifying logic-check summary"
#| echo: false

logic_summary |>
  kable()
```
